name: Nanatsuiro☆Drops DS - Touch de Hajimaru Hatsukoi Monogatari
original_name: ななついろ☆ドロップスDS タッチではじまる初恋物語
source:
A version based heavily on the anime with completely different scripts from the original.

Nanatsuiro Drops is a dating simulation/adventure game based on the anime of the same title. It tells the story of Masaharu Tsuwabuki who is transformed into Yuki-chan, a toy lamb every night because of a can of soft drink. To break the spell, he needs a special girl to collect all the stars bits that fell into the city during the night of meteor rain. To his surprise, this girl happens to be Akihime Sumomo, a classmate whom he hardly knew. There is one more catch, if he lets her know that he is Yuki-chan, he will be stuck as Yuki-chan for the rest of his life.For players who preferred pairing Masaharu up with heroines aside from Sumomo, here is your chance, since several other classmates make their appearance in this game, exploit every possibility and view all the different storylines. 

[From [url=https://www.play-asia.com/nanatsuiro-drops-touch-de-hajimaru-hatsukoi-monogatari-limited-/13/702e1d]Play-Asia[/url]]
translation:
很大程度上基于动画的版本，其剧本与原作完全不同。

Nanatsuiro Drops是一款基于同名动漫的约会模拟/冒险游戏。讲述了津瓦吹正治每天晚上因为一罐软饮料而变成小羊羔小雪的故事。为了打破这个咒语，他需要一个特殊的女孩来收集流星雨之夜落入城市的所有星星碎片。令他惊讶的是，这个女孩竟然是他素不相识的同学相桃秋姬。还有一个问题，如果他让她知道他是Yuki-chan，他将在余生中被困在Yuki-chan中。对于那些喜欢将Masaharu与Sumo之外的女主角配对的玩家来说，这是你的机会，因为其他几位同学也出现在这个游戏中，利用每一种可能性并查看所有不同的故事情节。

[来自[url=https://www.play-asia.com/nanatsuiro-drops-touch-de-hajimaru-hatsukoi-monogatari-limited-/13/702e1d]Play-Asia[/url]]
